description.en: MiMo monthly and plan Credit usage plus model listing carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供 MiMo 月度与套餐 Credits 用量及模型目录。

description.en: Add the serving key and, optionally, a console cookie for quota refresh.
description.zh: 填写推理密钥，并可选补充用于刷新额度的控制台 Cookie。

help_text.en: Optional. Paste the full cookie block from platform.xiaomimimo.com to refresh monthly and plan quota. Re-paste it when the session expires.
help_text.zh: 可选。从 platform.xiaomimimo.com 粘贴完整 Cookie，用于刷新月度与套餐额度；登录态过期后需重新粘贴。
